question: Identify the top 5 tallest players who have appeared as home player 8 in matches held in Italy and whose vision score exceeds 89. For each of these players, return their name, current age (in years), and average heading accuracy across all recorded attribute entries.

prediction.sql: SELECT p.XCL_123 AS name, (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_125)) AS current_age, AVG(pa.XCL_139) AS avg_heading_accuracy FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122 WHERE p.XCL_122 IN (SELECT m.XCL_068 FROM Match AS m JOIN Country AS c ON c.XCL_001 = m.XCL_007 WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'Italy' AND NOT m.XCL_068 IS NULL) AND p.XCL_122 IN (SELECT pa2.XCL_130 FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2 WHERE pa2.XCL_152 > 89) GROUP BY p.XCL_121 ORDER BY p.XCL_126 DESC LIMIT 5

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    p.XCL_123 AS name,
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.XCL_125)) AS current_age,
    AVG(pa.XCL_139) AS avg_heading_accuracy
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
WHERE p.XCL_122 IN (
    SELECT m.XCL_061
    FROM Match AS m
    JOIN Country AS c ON c.XCL_001 = m.XCL_007
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'Italy'
      AND m.XCL_061 IS NOT NULL
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
    WHERE pa2.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122 AND pa2.XCL_152 > 89
  )
GROUP BY p.XCL_121
ORDER BY p.XCL_126 DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    p.XCL_123 AS name,
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.XCL_125)) AS current_age,
    AVG(pa.XCL_139) AS avg_heading_accuracy
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
WHERE p.XCL_122 IN (
    SELECT m.XCL_068
    FROM Match AS m
    JOIN Country AS c ON c.XCL_001 = m.XCL_007
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'Italy'
      AND m.XCL_068 IS NOT NULL
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
    WHERE pa2.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122 AND pa2.XCL_152 > 89
  )
GROUP BY p.XCL_121
ORDER BY p.XCL_126 DESC
LIMIT 5

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
SELECT
    p.XCL_123 AS name,
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.XCL_125)) AS current_age,
    AVG(pa.XCL_139) AS avg_heading_accuracy
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
WHERE p.XCL_122 IN (
    SELECT m.XCL_068
    FROM Match AS m
    JOIN Country AS c ON c.XCL_001 = m.XCL_007
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'Italy'
      AND m.XCL_068 IS NOT NULL
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
    WHERE pa2.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122 AND pa2.XCL_152 > 89
  )
GROUP BY p.XCL_121
ORDER BY p.XCL_126 DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    p.XCL_123 AS name,
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.XCL_125)) AS current_age,
    AVG(pa.XCL_139) AS avg_heading_accuracy
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
WHERE p.XCL_122 IN (
    SELECT m.XCL_068
    FROM Match AS m
    JOIN Country AS c ON c.XCL_001 = m.XCL_007
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'Italy'
      AND m.XCL_068 IS NOT NULL
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
    WHERE pa2.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122 AND pa2.XCL_152 > 89
  )
GROUP BY p.XCL_121
ORDER BY p.XCL_126 DESC
LIMIT 5
